items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Willard Alexander was the booking agent for Count Basie and Benny Goodman’s orchestra? ... We got this call from Willard. ... Willard was a slave driver. He bought up everything he could buy up.
